notes: In the code the app presents itself as 'فرصة دراسية' (study-opportunity community: Q&A + articles); the repo is named blogstory and MaterialApp title is 'Linkati'. Theme asks for 'Poppins' but no font file is bundled, so the system Arabic font is used (as the real build would). Material 3 surface colour is approximated from ColorScheme.fromSeed(white). Relative-time strings follow the code's own formatter (e.g. 'منذ 3 ساعة'); 'votes'/'views' chips are English in the code. The block-ads button uses the repo's own assets/images/block_ads.png. Home is drawn as a signed-in non-admin user (admin dashboard button hidden); the native-ad slot is below the fold. Users, questions, answers and the slideshow banner are sample data.
